tool.title: discussion
tool.description: Put a question to a person or a sibling agent and receive an answer, to determine which harness this repository should become and which repositories are read from and written to. The two facts no file holds.

inputs.name: question
inputs.description: The question as put, with its candidates named. One question where one will do.

inputs.name: askedOf
inputs.description: `person` or `agent` — symmetric participants, recorded because the answers are evidence of different weight.

outputs.name: answer
outputs.description: The reply as received. Absent is a real result: it routes to `outcome: unsettled`, never to a guess.

selection.when: A fact is needed that no file in reach holds — which harness, or which repositories. Narrow the candidates from context first; a repository already carrying `cat-harness/cat-harness.json` is not a blank slate, and a question the agent could have answered itself wastes the one it is entitled to.
selection.limits: It cannot manufacture an answer. A participant may decline, and that is `outcome: unsettled` with what is still open — not an error and not a default. An agent that reaches for a documented default because nobody replied has produced a guess.
selection.cost: One round trip through a person's attention, which is the most expensive input in the system and the reason the skill's rule is to ask once.
